paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the difference in probing accuracy between two models, mBERT and XLM-R, across different multilayer perceptron (MLP) variations. The horizontal axis displays the MLP configuration labels: “hidden:[50], linear”, “hidden:[], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”. The vertical axis is labeled “% point difference” and represents a linear scale ranging from -0.25 to 0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Each category on the horizontal axis features two adjacent bars: a lighter blue bar representing mBERT and a darker blue bar representing XLM-R. For “hidden:[50], linear”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.08, while the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.04. For “hidden:[], linear”, the mBERT bar is near 0 and the XLM-R bar reaches around -0.12. For “hidden:[100], ReLU”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.04 and the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.08. Finally, for “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, the mBERT bar is about -0.14 and the XLM-R bar reaches a value of approximately 0.04. The bars are arranged alphabetically based on the category label, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
